_about: Thresholds read by descent_record.py. APPEND-ONLY: an entry, once
written, is never edited or deleted. To change a value, append a new
entry with the next seq for the same key; the loader takes the last
entry per key as current and keeps the rest as the record of what the
instrument used before. test_descent_record.py pins a digest of the
shipped prefix (seq 1-16), so an in-place edit fails the check while an
status: PLACEHOLDER = chosen to make the constructed fixtures readable,
not measured on any unit, road or trailer. Every value shipped here is
PLACEHOLDER. Upgrading one to MEASURED needs a T1/T2 run and a new entry
